indications_and_usage: Uses Handwash to help decrease bacteria on the skin Recommended for repeated use
warnings: Warnings For external use only When using this product do not use in or near the eyes. In case of contact, rinse eyes thoroughly with water. Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation or rash appears and lasts Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.

dosage_and_administration: Directions Wet hands Apply product and thoroughly cover hands with lather Rinse well and dry hands completely
